name: Base Torres lookout
region: Torres del Paine National Park, east sector
why: The three granite towers over their glacier lake: the picture of Patagonia, earned in one long day.
book: Buy the park entry online before you arrive (pasesparques.cl); rangers check it at the gate. Refugio Chileno sells food and must be booked to sleep.
water: Streams and Refugio Chileno half way.
dangers: Paso de los Vientos, after the first hour, is named for its gusts: hold on to your poles.
The last hour is a steep boulder moraine; in snow or ice turn back.
Rangers close the moraine to people going up in the afternoon in high season.
turnaround: Be at Refugio Chileno by 11:30, or stop at the Chileno valley: the moraine and the way back take 5 more hours.

points.name: Hotel Las Torres, Torres del Paine
points.note: The Welcome Centre and park bus stop are 10 minutes before the hotel.

points.name: Paso de los Vientos, Valle Ascencio
points.note: After 1 h of climbing: the trail turns into the Ascencio valley above the river.

points.name: Refugio Chileno
points.note: Hut, toilets and water. Then 1 h of forest to Campamento Torres.

points.name: Mirador Base Las Torres
points.note: About 870 m, after 45-60 min on the boulder moraine: the towers over the lake.
